name: @singitai/plugin-singit
description: ElizaOS plugin for SingIt: free crypto/FX prices and model listing via SingIt's MCP server, optional paid web search/page reading with a SingIt API key, and optional x402-paid chat on SingIt Ask (Base; needs the optional @x402/evm peer).

SINGIT_API_KEY.description: SingIt API key for paid web search and page reading. The owner sets server-side daily and per-request limits on the key in the SingIt app.

SINGIT_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Optional 0x-prefixed EVM key for x402-paid chat on Base. Paid chat is only offered when both spend ceilings are also set.

SINGIT_MAX_PER_CALL_USD.description: Required for paid chat. Client-side per-call spend ceiling in USD. The model cannot raise it.

SINGIT_MAX_PER_DAY_USD.description: Required for paid chat. Client-side per-UTC-day spend ceiling in USD. The model cannot raise it.

SINGIT_MCP_URL.description: Optional MCP server URL. Defaults to https://app.singitai.app/mcp.

SINGIT_ASK_BASE_URL.description: Optional SingIt Ask base URL. Defaults to https://ask.singitai.app.
